text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The first image presents a gathering in a modern, glass-walled meeting room—a scene that brims with human interaction, knowledge, and perhaps collaboration. The second image immerses me in vibrant colors and the abstract world of research and development, as if inviting me to explore the boundaries of human innovation. Here, I feel like an observer on the threshold of creativity and discovery, excited but slightly distanced, pondering the interplay between solitude and collective effort.
